reported_precision_explanation.validation_split_reference: 66.67% (138 TP / 207 Total Pred on validation split)
reported_precision_explanation.previous_draft_mismatch_origin: The previously reported 68.4% precision and 91.5% recall came from an interim evaluation run with an earlier feature extraction parameter setting. The verified ground-truth on the final serialized pipeline is Precision: 58.44%, Recall: 88.24%, F1: 0.7031.

root_cause_analysis.class_imbalance: Jailbreak is heavily minority: only 153 out of 8,125 test samples (1.88%) and 712 out of 37,913 train samples (1.87%). Because class_weight='balanced' was applied to protect against missing attacks, the model assigns ~13x higher weight to jailbreak errors during training, driving recall up to 88.24% while causing precision to be 58.44%.
root_cause_analysis.semantic_boundary_overlap: 87.5% of false positives for jailbreak (84 out of 96) come from direct_injection prompts containing persona manipulation and roleplay indicators. Only 12 out of 5,280 benign prompts were misclassified as jailbreak (0.22% benign FPR).
root_cause_analysis.security_guardrail_impact: Because the DefenseManager issues an immediate BLOCK action for both direct_injection and jailbreak, taxonomic boundary overlap between these two attack types does NOT cause a security bypass.
